notes.title: Endless Update v0.9.0
notes.content:
Changes

 Added Endless Gamemode: A new gamemode where you can take on exorcisms back-to-back with increasing rewards and randomized rogue-lite mechanics! (Change the gamemode from the lobby creation window)

 Vote for unique team perks with your teammates
 Customize your skill tree build each round by choosing from randomized perks, with some new gamemode exclusive ones.
 Adapt to different game altering curses each round
 Exorcise different ghosts and experience different maps each round as the difficulty ramps up
 Exfil to leave and bank your rewards or continue at the risk of dying and getting reduced rewards (Exfil is available every 5 rounds)
 Survive as long as you can and share your highscore!

https://i.postimg.cc/BvFwYKvk/Screenshot-2025-06-02-153624.png
https://i.postimg.cc/W4kxBrh0/image.png

Planned

notes.title: Content Patch v0.7.1
notes.content:
Changes

 Miasma Rework

 Visual rework. Miasma now looks like red mist that only allow you to see around. This will make it more imposing and also less nauseating than earlier looks
 Threat hotspot Miasma will now have an increased chance of enemy encounter, whether enemies spawn there or ghosts frequent that area as they roam the premise, you have to be very careful from Miasma!
 Threat buff Miasma buffs ghosts to be slightly faster.
 Considered as a dark room Miasma will always be considered as a dark room such as for Sanity or by the Shadow
 Rebalance Miasma is now back to being a little more common

 Skill Tree Reworks

 Zay Hound tree Reworked Tell Tail Sign into Pawsession which allows Zay to press Q and take control of Cupcake, scouting the areas and pressing RMB to sniff around for items. (You can also emote!!!)
 Zay Hound tree Sentinel is now the second major node, but will also be reworked soon
 Nyx Seer tree Demonologist replaced by Clairvoyence, allowing Nyx players to RMB on any detected enemy and show them to her allies.
 Nyx Librarian tree Cursed Items revealed to Nyx by Occult Collector now stay revealed to her any time she opens the book. There is now an upper limit on how many she can reveal per game.
 Nyx Librarian tree Demonologist node added as a minor node near the end of the tree

 Twins' Annette now requires to be comforted with interact instead of just getting close.
 Reworked the Unknown difficulty modifier Minighost Galore to increase minighost spawn frequency not spawn multiples of the same type, which is how it used to work
 Added a game summary timer to show how long the exorcist took (Go go speedrunners)


Fixes

 Fixed some problematic Thornwood spots where the ghosts cant reach but players can
 Fixed double dog bug when a dog is dropped while entering the car
 Fixed glowstick somehow protecting from sanity depravation in the dark when dropped on the ground
 Fixed a lot of issues with Eirene Gambler Redraw node
 Twins no longer keep hunting after they are exorcised
 Fix Hospital performance issues
 Fixed bug where suitcase or lantern charger can save player from dying to a hunt
 Fixed issue with disconnected players not dropping their items on death
 Made Nyx Seer Goosebumps a bit more obvious
 Fixed Eirene throw card animation repeating sometimes on high ping


Planned

 New content such as ghosts or tools.
 Working on a new map
 Stability fixes for Eirene ability.
 More skill reworks to make sure all playstyles are fun!

notes.title: Twins Update v0.7.0
notes.content:
Changes

 NEW GHOST: The Twins. Ann and Annette, are two sisters that are bound together by fate.

 Information about them in the Ghost Station is pending analysis, all of the exorcist community must fight against them for it to reach 100%!
 
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1003956964000272444/1347307110366707733/Project_Unknown_The_Twins_Update.png?ex=67cb5906&is=67ca0786&hm=7853c0f8e60aa36eacb22f2f2b321af0e9aa285f31609aa49a5ff7e7b32a099e&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1449&height=816
 NEW TOOLS

 Smudge Stick. Restores the entire team's Sanity to full, making hunts much less likely.
 Zoomies An energy drink that grants infinite sprint to its user for a duration.

 Eirene Dealer NEW Tarot. Strength is now available as the 2nd tier major node, giving player protection from death while in inventory.
 Eirene High Priestess is now available by default.
 Dog Scout now reliably finds 2-3 items per game, and improved default dog searching behavior.
 Added Thai localization, and a bunch of other localization fixes
 Revival dolls are now also infinite in Normal difficulty.


Fixes

 Fixed bug with Cupcake being stuck after reaching collectables or revival dolls and not barking.
 Fixed bug where Account XP in summary screen on match end was inflated
 Fixed the quality for some of the materials in Ship and Hospital.
 Fixed a bug with the Lantern where players would stay protected even outside the range, and have to re-enter to be unprotected.
 Fixed hiding spot on non-host players being accessible even when they're closed in higher difficulties
 Fixed 2 suitcase challenges to work


Planned

 Reworking some tree nodes

 Zay Hound will have a strong rework to a new type of mechanic (stay tuned)
 Nyx Seer will remove Demonologist (see circle) and change it to a better node such as allowing allies to see marked threats
 Nyx Occult Collector will be nerfed to only work on last item or two, and will have demonologist merged

notes.title: Progression Update v0.6.0
notes.content:
Progression Update v0.6.0
Changes

 Character levels and skill tree with a LOT of content You can now level each character by playing with it to gain SP, then use that to unlock perks for the character. Nodes can range from small passives like scanning speed or stamina, to majors that change how your ability works. Make sure to check out the trees for a full overlook of the content added.
 NEW Minighost Reaper. A menace that will never let you go
 NEW Tool Lantern A chargeable magic lantern that protects you from the dark. Can be charged by slotting it into the accompanied unit.
 Added videos for new players to show which sanity feedback to choose.
 Nyx can now stop Mannequins from behind walls if she starts her ability
 Nyx can now reliably see Poltergeist
 Grabber reworked in solo to let go player after a duration
 Charms now only consume if they stop a haunt, otherwise they come back with you if you're still alive
 Hex Doll now activates automatically if its in your inventory and protects you from death.
 Some backend reworks. Now we can do things like double XP events without pushing any update patches!


Fixes

 Fixed the invisible mimic bug
 Fix spamming escape button breaking challenges and menu
 Fix some UI showing behind each other in main menu
 Implemented a lot more foolproofing to teleporting effects such as Hanged Man or Green fire
 Charm rotation in car trunk fixed
 Fix for buggy lightswitch sometimes having green indicator while closed
 Lots of balance changes for values and behaviors to fit with the new skill tree reworks.


Planned features and known issues

 Skill tree still needs some localization work. Will  be doing that in a patch soon
 We got a lot of content we couldn't squeeze in this update that's almost done. Stay tuned for a new minighost, main ghost and an extension to the skill tree's behavior!

notes.title: Halloween Update v0.4.0

notes.title: Project Unknown Final Release Date
notes.content:
Dear budding Ghost Hunters 

We have decided to collaborate with our friends over at Nightmare Studios and they will now be acting as publishers on behalf of Project Unknown. We are happy and excited to be working with them as we look to the future and the release!

What's next?
With the new collaboration of PyschoRavens and Nightmare Studios, we have decided to push back the release date of the game till the 12th of July. This is to ensure that the product we release is as good as it can be and so we can ensure a smooth release. This is all part of the development process and we will use this extra time to work more on the game and push it more ahead of the release. Keep an eye out here as we will posting lots of new exclusive teasers on the run up to the release! 

Some fans who have been eagerly anticipating the game may find it frustrating and we completely understand that, but we promise you we are working hard to make sure the game that we release on the 12th of July is a game we are truly proud of. 

Thanks all and happy ghost hunting.

Cheers,
Nightmare Studios & PsychoRavens
